data.message: Retrieving the official financial statement PDF from the CSE document repository
Document secured and staged for processing
Running multi-dimensional financial health diagnostics with LLM (this may take a minute)...
Health diagnostics finalised for CTEA.N0000 — overall score: 86/100 · Good

standardHealthChecks.name: Liquidity Health
standardHealthChecks.description: The company maintains an exceptionally robust liquidity profile with a current ratio of 5.41x (Current Assets of LKR 22.63B against Current Liabilities of LKR 4.18B) and a quick ratio of ~4.36x, backed by substantial cash reserves and liquid financial assets.

standardHealthChecks.name: Profitability Health
standardHealthChecks.description: Profitability surged significantly; quarterly revenue expanded 27.8% YoY to LKR 5.13B. Gross margin expanded to 38.3% (from 35.0%), and net profit margin reached 19.8% (up from 12.2% in Q1 2025), with profit after tax more than doubling to LKR 1.01B.

standardHealthChecks.name: Debt Management
standardHealthChecks.description: Capital structure is highly conservative. Total liabilities to equity ratio stands at 25.7% with no significant long-term bank debt (mainly lease obligations of LKR 1.18B total). Interest coverage is extremely safe at over 33x.

standardHealthChecks.name: Cash Flow Health
standardHealthChecks.description: Operating cash flow recovered sharply to LKR 661.9M (compared to LKR 18.8M in the prior year period). With modest capital expenditures of LKR 55.4M, free cash flow generation was solid at LKR 606.6M.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Inventory Efficiency & Working Capital
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Inventories reduced by 5.5% YoY to LKR 3.34B despite a 27.8% increase in quarterly sales, demonstrating improved inventory turn and efficient supply chain management.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: Critical for beverage manufacturers to prevent working capital lockup, product degradation, and excess inventory storage costs.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Earnings Quality & Foreign Exchange Exposure
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Foreign Exchange Gains contributed LKR 868.4M (71.8% of Profit Before Tax of LKR 1.21B), indicating that reported net income growth is heavily bolstered by currency movements rather than core operating earnings alone.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: As an export-heavy FMCG producer in Sri Lanka, volatile currency exchange rates significantly impact reported net margins and top-line earnings stability.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Product Category Mix & Margin Performance
dynamicHealthChecks.description: The core Tea Bags segment dominates revenue (LKR 4.37B, up 28.8% YoY) with a high segment gross margin of 39.9%. High-growth categories like RTD (Ready-To-Drink) expanded 90.8% YoY (to LKR 81.5M) with a 37.7% gross margin.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: Product mix diversification into higher-margin packaging formats (Tea Bags, RTD) drives overall margin resilience against raw material cost swings.

recommendations: Focus on expanding core operating income to rely less on foreign exchange gains for earnings growth.
Continue accelerating high-margin Ready-To-Drink (RTD) and value-added tea bag segments to further boost organic gross margins.
Optimize capital allocation for idle cash reserves and current financial assets (LKR 6.19B) toward growth capex or higher yield opportunities.
Monitor trade receivable balances (LKR 8.20B) closely to ensure strong cash conversion as export volumes grow.
result.analysisNotes: Dilmah Ceylon Tea Company PLC presents an extraordinarily strong balance sheet characterized by low leverage, high liquidity, and robust profit margins for Q1 2026. However, stakeholders should note that over 70% of pre-tax earnings in this quarter originated from foreign exchange gains.
